capabilities: Detect scripture references automatically in View and Edit modes
Index all references into a searchable, filterable concordance
Find related notes that mention a reference, including containing ranges
Export the full concordance as a Markdown file
Parse and display references in multiple languages
disambiguation: Not a Bible reader or translation tool; it only detects and indexes references already written in your notes.
extras: Author warns that unofficial forks exist and are not supported; security/privacy details are in separate linked docs; initial index build may take up to 5 minutes or more on large vaults.
problem: Bible references scattered as plain text across many notes are not detected, linked, or searchable as a whole in Obsidian.

so as not to conflict with the menu from the tra.VER:ture plugin (if installed)

summary: Scripture reference parser and indexer that detects Bible references across notes and builds a searchable, exportable concordance.
